_commentaire: This manifest is a coreupdate_config.json from the Veille project, taken as-is.
The only addition: packageKey, which carries the deferral counter and is never
derived from AppName — an automatic derivation would mean that a display
rename would hand back their deferrals to every user in the fleet.
PascalCase keys and PSADT names are accepted as-is:
Note: 7zFM is a PROCESS name, not a bundle ID. SIGKILL by PID targets it
via the executable name; declaring a bundleIdentifier is still preferable
